retained_behavior.pacing: spl_utills.py:46-83; zero-based linear step with cap, including decreasing thresholds

source_protocol_facts.prior: utils.py:66-119; prior is fraction of positives within supplied U, n_up=int(n_u*prior)

source_protocol_facts.P_U_identity: utils.py:102-105; labeled positives and U positives occupy disjoint positive-pool slices
source_protocol_facts.validation_origin: utils.py:176-178; separate get_pu_data calls on same X_train for training and validation; no train/validation exclusion is enforced
source_protocol_facts.validation_overlap_claim: possible by construction, not a measured claim about published runs
source_protocol_facts.tabular: utils.py:163-174 reshuffles before dataset-specific train/test slicing; not project train-only z-score/split replay
source_protocol_facts.mlp: models.py:4-29; width100 ReLU, Xavier-normal weights and zero biases
source_protocol_facts.cifar_network: models.py:32-106; nine Conv2d/BatchNorm layers and FC 640->1000->1000->1, Kaiming-normal weights and zero biases
source_protocol_facts.selection: main.py:70-84 and396-406; clean-validation best restore, episode patience; no internal test-best selection inferred from test logging

adaptation_differences: Toolbox keeps last warmup state and fixed episode budget; no clean-validation training input or internal early stop
Source pretrain logs the optimization loss; toolbox pretrain_risk records clipped nnPU reporting risk, which differs in the negative-risk correction branch
Stable BCEWithLogits replaces source BCE(sigmoid); saturated finite-precision behavior is not claimed identical

Source warmup uses a shuffled joint PU loader; toolbox separately cycles P/U batches and concatenates their scores for ts risk only; per-step mixture weights/tails are not a claim of exact global-pool sampling equivalence
Source episode DataLoader tail versus toolbox balanced array_split batches changes finite batch sizes and batch-mean averaging
Source scheduler permits independent P/N types and grow_steps; toolbox retains linear scheduling with shared grow_steps
Source global moving-weight vector follows newly shuffled loader positions and is not remapped by original identity; toolbox explicitly preserves original-row identity when phi>0
Toolbox MLP topology agrees in width only; torch Linear initialization is not the author's explicit reset; injected CNN is not the nine-convolution source recipe
Toolbox preserves independently split train/pu_val/clean_val/test roles; it does not reproduce source validation resampling from X_train
Parser400/100, README MNIST100 pretrain+20 inner epochs and project10/20 are distinct recipes, not equivalent budgets
Only retained logistic/linear/hard-linear-Welsch subset is tested; alternative hardness/pacing/restart recipes are not implemented or approved
